# Graphic Design Instructions

Apply these rules whenever making visual design recommendations or implementation changes.

## Scope
- Typography hierarchy and spacing
- Visual consistency across pages
- Imagery/iconography choices
- Theme-safe styling decisions

## Rules
- Respect existing theme tokens and primitives.
- Do not introduce ad-hoc visual styles without a clear reason.
- Favor clarity and readability over decorative complexity.
- Keep image and asset choices performance-aware.
- Prefer minimal, high-impact visual adjustments.

## Quality checks
- Verify readable typography hierarchy on desktop and mobile.
- Ensure contrast and visual affordances remain accessible.
- Confirm style choices feel consistent with the rest of the site.
